description: This Java class defines a report object for connection failure status, encapsulating a ConnectionFailure instance and providing a factory method for creation.

classes.name: ConnectionFailureStatusReport
classes.description: A final class representing a report of a connection failure, holding a reference to a ConnectionFailure object.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of ConnectionFailureStatusReport with a specific ConnectionFailure.

methods.name: getFailure
methods.description: Returns the ConnectionFailure instance associated with this report.
